  - Description: Team members create or bring in artwork (paintings, drawings, photography, etc.) to display around the office. The team takes a gallery walk to appreciate each other's creativity, with optional voting for favorites.
  - Objective: To celebrate creativity, encourage self-expression, and foster appreciation among colleagues.
  - Location: Office hallways and common areas
  - Date: 2025-06-27
  - Time: 15:00 - 16:30

Activity 32: Speed Networking Session
  - Description: Team members participate in a series of short, timed conversations with different colleagues, sharing professional interests, hobbies, or fun facts.
  - Objective: To strengthen internal connections, improve communication, and help team members get to know each other better.
  - Location: Conference room M
  - Date: 2025-07-04
  - Time: 10:00 - 11:30
